titleEn: Edit and resubmit, or delete, a template

undo.note: an edit is re-reviewed by Meta and a delete frees the name only after 30 days

ar: ازاي اعدل القالب بعد ما اترفض؟
en: How do I edit a rejected template?
How do I delete a template?

steps: Open the template, Edit and resubmit (a rejected one keeps its name; the category is editable only before approval)
Delete asks for confirmation; every campaign using it must finish first; an approved name cannot be reused for 30 days
edgeCases: An approved template can be edited once per 24 hours and 10 times per 30 days: blocked locally with the time it unlocks
A pending template cannot be edited
Two edits at once: the second gets edit_in_progress
Deleting a template a campaign or queued message still uses is refused (in_use)
A disabled template cannot be deleted
Deleting removes one language only, never every language of the name
assistantNote: edit resubmits to Meta; delete cannot be undone; both need the owner's confirmation
